channel.title: Joshua Moreau Roberts — Latest from Facebook
channel.description: Current events commentary from Joshua Moreau Roberts, Vancouver, BC. Bold. Unapologetic. Unafraid. Summaries of his latest public Facebook posts.

item.title: History: Romania's revolution — the face that deceived a nation
item.description: A history reel on Romania's revolution — a leader who looked like a kind grandfather, behind horrors too dark for a horror film.

item.title: Ireland refuses to hand refugees over to a draft
item.description: Ireland refuses to hand Ukrainian refugees over to a draft — while Western leaders insist the fighting continue, they're not the ones pulled from their families.

item.title: The Bible and the Quran — a debate reel
item.description: A reel on the Bible and the Quran — part of his running religion debate series.

item.title: NVIDIA and the espionage question
item.description: On the NVIDIA espionage case — the man at the center shouldn't have been forced out. Someone who has learned the lesson is the one you keep.

item.title: Church fires in Canada: the numbers since 2021
item.description: The reality of church fires and vandalism in Canada since May 2021 — dozens of churches burned to the ground, and the religious hatred here lands hardest on Jews and Christians.

item.title: Meanwhile in Canada: taxes and the cost of living
item.description: A reel contrasting 50–60% tax rates with places that fund everything on a small VAT, and asking what Canadians actually get for it.

item.title: Rutte asks Portugal to pay more while its people struggle
item.description: NATO's Rutte wants Portugal to pay more for Ukraine while its own people struggle — a political class that has forgotten who governments are supposed to serve.

item.title: Iran's economy is collapsing
item.description: Iran's economy is collapsing — inflation eats savings, unemployment eats household income, and when a system can't correct itself, unrest follows.

item.title: Carney, Telesat and a $2.3B contract
item.description: A Star exclusive — Carney sets up a conflict-of-interest screen after a friend's firm landed a $2.3B contract.

item.title: The MQ-9 Reaper: one AI drone to be reckoned with
item.description: The MQ-9 Reaper — one AI drone that is a force to be reckoned with.
